title: CBX417-301 - CBX-417 + docetaxel versus placebo + docetaxel in previously treated advanced NSCLC (synthetic)
description: Flagship synthetic Phase 2/3 oncology trial: 468 screened, 420 randomized 1:1, data cutoff 2025-03-31. Three layers (raw EDC/vendor exports with documented data problems, SDTM built from the corrected data, ADaM derived from SDTM) plus an answer key, record-level lineage and a SQLite database of all SDTM and ADaM tables. Everything is fictional; no real subjects, sites, sponsors or products.

columns.name: RFSTDTC

columns.label: Subject Death Flag

columns.name: AGE
columns.label: Age
columns.derivation: Age in years at informed consent, as collected on the demographics form.

columns.name: RACE
columns.label: Race
columns.derivation: One checkbox ticked → that race; more than one → MULTIPLE (individual values in SUPPDM RACE1/RACE2); "not reported" checkbox → NOT REPORTED.
columns.notes: Classic SDTM race values are used. In the NCI CT package dated 2026-03-27 there is no codelist named RACE; the values WHITE, ASIAN, BLACK OR AFRICAN AMERICAN, AMERICAN INDIAN OR ALASKA NATIVE and NOT REPORTED appear in RACEC (Race As Collected), which spells the Pacific Islander value NATIVE HAWAIIAN OR PACIFIC ISLANDER. MULTIPLE follows the SDTMIG convention for more than one race.

columns.name: ETHNIC
columns.label: Ethnicity
columns.notes: HISPANIC OR LATINO / NOT HISPANIC OR LATINO / NOT REPORTED; in the 2026-03-27 CT these values live in ETHNICC (Ethnicity As Collected).

columns.name: ACTARMCD
columns.label: Actual Arm Code
columns.derivation: Arm actually received, from the kit content in EX. Null with ARMNRS = UNPLANNED TREATMENT for the two subjects who received a mix of placebo and CBX-417 kits; ACTARMUD then describes what was received.

columns.name: ARMNRS
columns.label: Reason Arm and/or Actual Arm is Null
columns.derivation: SCREEN FAILURE for non-randomized subjects, ASSIGNED, NOT TREATED for randomized subjects who were never dosed, UNPLANNED TREATMENT when the treatment received does not match a planned arm (dispensing error).

Pre-dose samples on the day of first dose fall in SCREENING because collection times are compared with the first-dose time.

columns.name: SESTDTC

columns.name: SESTDY

datasets.name: ta
datasets.label: Trial Arms
datasets.structure: One record per planned element per arm
datasets.description: Planned sequence of elements for each arm.

columns.name: TAETORD
columns.label: Planned Order of Element within Arm

Pre-dose samples on the day of first dose fall in SCREENING because collection times are compared with the first-dose time.

datasets.name: te
datasets.label: Trial Elements
datasets.structure: One record per element
datasets.description: Element definitions with start and end rules.

datasets.name: ts
datasets.label: Trial Summary
datasets.structure: One record per trial summary parameter value
datasets.description: Key protocol facts: phase, blinding, control type, stratification factors, planned enrollment, endpoints, data cutoff and standards versions.

datasets.name: adsl
datasets.label: Subject-Level Analysis Dataset
datasets.structure: One record per randomized subject
datasets.description: All 420 randomized subjects (screen failures are excluded by design). Population flags, treatment variables, stratification factors as randomized, disposition and key baseline characteristics.

columns.name: HEIGHTBL
columns.label: Baseline Height (cm)
columns.derivation: Screening VS HEIGHT (cm).

columns.name: WEIGHTBL
columns.label: Baseline Weight (kg)
columns.derivation: Last VS WEIGHT (VSSTRESN, kg) on or before TRTSDT; RANDDT is used for subjects who were never treated.

columns.name: BMIBL
columns.label: Baseline BMI (kg/m2)
columns.derivation: WEIGHTBL / (HEIGHTBL/100)^2, rounded to 1 decimal.

columns.name: BSABL
columns.label: Baseline BSA (m2)
columns.derivation: Mosteller: sqrt(HEIGHTBL x WEIGHTBL / 3600), rounded to 2 decimals.

columns.name: ECOGBL
columns.label: Baseline ECOG Performance Status
columns.derivation: Last RS ECOG101 (RSSTRESN) on or before TRTSDT (RANDDT if never treated).

columns.name: PRLINES
columns.label: Number of Prior Lines of Therapy

columns.name: STRAT1R
columns.label: Stratum 1 as Randomized (ECOG PS)
columns.derivation: ECOG stratum as entered in the IxRS at randomization (SUPPDM STRATECG) - not the CRF value in ECOGBL; eight subjects were stratified incorrectly and are analyzed as randomized.

columns.name: STRAT2R
columns.label: Stratum 2 as Randomized (Prior Anti-PD-(L)1)
columns.derivation: Prior anti-PD-(L)1 stratum as entered in the IxRS (SUPPDM STRATIO).

columns.name: TRT01A
columns.label: Actual Treatment for Period 01
columns.derivation: Actual treatment: CBX-417 + Docetaxel if any EX record has EXTRT = CBX-417, otherwise Placebo + Docetaxel; null for never-treated subjects (SAP rule: any exposure to active drug counts as active).

columns.name: TRTSDT
columns.label: Date of First Exposure to Treatment
columns.derivation: Date part of the earliest EX record start (any study treatment).

columns.name: TRTSDTM
columns.label: Datetime of First Exposure to Treatment
columns.derivation: Earliest EX start datetime (the Cycle 1 dosing record carries a time), used for ADEG baseline selection.

columns.name: TRTEDT
columns.label: Date of Last Exposure to Treatment
columns.derivation: Latest EXENDTC across all EX records.

columns.name: TRTDURD
columns.label: Total Treatment Duration (days)
columns.derivation: TRTEDT - TRTSDT + 1 (days).

columns.name: EOTSTT
columns.label: End of Treatment Status
columns.derivation: DISCONTINUED when a DS record with DSSCAT = STUDY TREATMENT exists, otherwise ONGOING for treated subjects.

columns.name: EOSSTT
columns.label: End of Study Status
columns.derivation: DISCONTINUED when a DS record with DSSCAT = STUDY PARTICIPATION exists, otherwise ONGOING.

columns.name: LSTALVDT
columns.label: Date Last Known Alive
columns.derivation: Latest date on or before the data cutoff on which the subject was known to be alive: visit, assessment, dosing and disposition dates plus survival contacts with SSSTRESC = ALIVE (contacts recorded as DEAD or UNKNOWN are excluded).

columns.name: SAFFL
columns.label: Safety Population Flag
columns.derivation: Y when TRTSDT is not missing (received at least one dose of any study treatment).

columns.name: EFFFL
columns.label: Efficacy Population Flag
columns.derivation: Y for ITT subjects with a baseline tumor assessment (TR SUMDIAM on or before randomization) and at least one post-baseline response assessment, or death within 49 days of randomization (first scheduled assessment + window).

columns.name: PPROTFL
columns.label: Per-Protocol Population Flag
columns.derivation: Y for treated subjects without a major deviation in the categories ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA, INVESTIGATIONAL PRODUCT, EFFICACY ASSESSMENT or PROHIBITED THERAPY (DV, DVSCAT = MAJOR).

datasets.name: adae
datasets.label: Adverse Events Analysis Dataset (OCCDS)
datasets.structure: One record per adverse event per subject
datasets.description: All SDTM AE records for randomized subjects with imputed analysis dates, treatment-emergent flag and first-occurrence flags.

columns.name: TRTSDT
columns.label: Date of First Exposure to Treatment

columns.name: TRTEDT
columns.label: Date of Last Exposure to Treatment

columns.name: AETERM
columns.label: Reported Term for the Adverse Event

columns.name: ASTDT
columns.label: Analysis Start Date
columns.derivation: AESTDTC when complete. Missing day: the first of the month, unless the month equals the month of TRTSDT, in which case TRTSDT is used. Missing month and day: 1 January, unless the year equals the year of TRTSDT, in which case TRTSDT is used. An imputed start is never later than AENDT. ASTDTF records the imputed component (D or M).

columns.name: AENDT
columns.label: Analysis End Date
columns.derivation: AEENDTC when complete; missing day imputed to the last day of the month, missing month to 31 December, and capped at the death date and the data cutoff. AENDTF records the imputed component.

columns.name: AREL
columns.label: Analysis Causality
columns.derivation: AEREL when collected; missing causality is imputed as RELATED (conservative SAP rule) - three events have an unresolved causality query.

columns.name: TRTEMFL
columns.label: Treatment Emergent Analysis Flag
columns.derivation: Y when ASTDT >= TRTSDT and ASTDT <= TRTEDT + 30 days.

columns.name: AOCCFL
columns.label: 1st Occurrence of Any TEAE Flag
columns.derivation: Y on the first treatment-emergent event per subject (chronological by ASTDT, then AESEQ).

columns.name: AOCCSFL
columns.label: 1st Occurrence of SOC Flag
columns.derivation: Y on the first treatment-emergent event per subject and system organ class.

columns.name: AOCCPFL
columns.label: 1st Occurrence of Preferred Term Flag
columns.derivation: Y on the first treatment-emergent event per subject and preferred term.

datasets.name: adlb
datasets.label: Laboratory Analysis Dataset (BDS)
datasets.structure: One record per subject, parameter and analysis visit
datasets.description: Laboratory results in SI units with baseline, change, reference-range indicators and CTCAE v5-style toxicity grades.

columns.name: AVISIT
columns.label: Analysis Visit
columns.derivation: BASELINE for the ABLFL record; the collected VISIT for scheduled records; unscheduled records are windowed to the nearest cycle visit (Cycle 1 Day 8: study days 2-11; Cycle n Day 1: target day 1 + 21(n-1) +/- 10 days) and left blank after the treatment period.

columns.name: ABLFL
columns.label: Baseline Record Flag
columns.derivation: Y on the last non-missing result on or before TRTSDT (RANDDT for never-treated subjects); records with LBSTAT = NOT DONE are excluded from ADLB.

columns.name: CHG
columns.label: Change from Baseline
columns.derivation: AVAL - BASE for post-baseline records.

columns.name: PCHG
columns.label: Percent Change from Baseline
columns.derivation: 100 x (AVAL - BASE) / BASE for post-baseline records with a non-zero baseline.

columns.name: ATOXGR
columns.label: Analysis Toxicity Grade
columns.derivation: CTCAE v5-style grade computed from AVAL and the reference limits (ALT/AST: >ULN, >3x, >5x, >20x; bilirubin: >ULN, >1.5x, >3x, >10x; neutrophils: <LLN, <1.5, <1.0, <0.5 x10^9/L; platelets: <LLN, <75, <50, <25 x10^9/L; hemoglobin: <LLN, <100, <80 g/L). Simplification: grading always uses the upper/lower limit of normal rather than the CTCAE baseline-abnormal rules.

columns.name: ONTRTFL
columns.label: On Treatment Record Flag
columns.derivation: Y when TRTSDT < ADT <= TRTEDT + 30 days.

columns.name: ANL01FL
columns.label: Analysis Flag 01
columns.notes: One analysis record per subject, parameter and analysis visit: the scheduled record when present, otherwise the latest unscheduled record within the visit window.

datasets.name: advs
datasets.label: Vital Signs Analysis Dataset (BDS)
datasets.structure: One record per subject, parameter and analysis visit
datasets.description: Vital-sign parameters with baseline and change from baseline.

columns.name: ANL01FL
columns.label: Analysis Flag 01
columns.notes: One analysis record per subject, parameter and analysis visit: the scheduled record when present, otherwise the latest unscheduled record within the visit window.

datasets.name: adeg
datasets.label: ECG Analysis Dataset (BDS)
datasets.structure: One record per subject, parameter and analysis visit
datasets.description: QTcF and mean heart rate with baseline (last pre-dose value, using datetimes because the Cycle 1 Day 1 ECG is post-dose) and multi-response criteria for QTcF categories.

columns.name: ABLFL
columns.label: Baseline Record Flag
columns.derivation: Y on the last record with a datetime before TRTSDTM (the Cycle 1 Day 1 ECG is post-dose, so screening is normally the baseline); SDTM EGLOBXFL identifies the same record.

columns.name: ANL01FL
columns.label: Analysis Flag 01
columns.notes: One analysis record per subject, parameter and analysis visit: the scheduled record when present, otherwise the latest unscheduled record within the visit window.

datasets.name: adrs
datasets.label: Response Analysis Dataset (BDS)
datasets.structure: One record per subject, parameter and assessment
datasets.description: Per-visit investigator response (OVRLRESP) plus derived best overall response (BOR, unconfirmed) and confirmed best overall response (CBOR) used for ORR.

columns.name: PARAMCD
columns.label: Parameter Code
columns.derivation: OVRLRESP = investigator response at each assessment; BOR = best overall response (unconfirmed); CBOR = confirmed best overall response. CBOR: CR requires a second CR at least 28 days later, PR a subsequent CR/PR at least 28 days later; otherwise SD when a CR/PR/SD occurs at least 35 days after randomization, else PD, else NE.

columns.name: AVAL
columns.label: Analysis Value
columns.derivation: Numeric response code: CR = 1, PR = 2, SD = 3, PD = 4, NE = 5.

columns.name: ANL01FL
columns.label: Analysis Flag 01
columns.derivation: Y for assessments up to and including the first PD and on or before the start of new anticancer therapy.
columns.notes: One analysis record per subject, parameter and analysis visit: the scheduled record when present, otherwise the latest unscheduled record within the visit window.

datasets.name: adtr
datasets.label: Tumor Results Analysis Dataset (BDS)
datasets.structure: One record per subject, parameter and assessment
datasets.description: Sum of diameters by visit with baseline, change and percent change, plus the best percent change (BPCHG) used for waterfall plots.

columns.name: AVAL
columns.label: Analysis Value
columns.derivation: Sum of target-lesion diameters (mm) for PARAMCD = SUMDIAM; best percent change from baseline for PARAMCD = BPCHG (minimum PCHG among analysis records).

columns.name: ANL01FL
columns.label: Analysis Flag 01
columns.notes: One analysis record per subject, parameter and analysis visit: the scheduled record when present, otherwise the latest unscheduled record within the visit window.

datasets.name: adtte
datasets.label: Time-to-Event Analysis Dataset (BDS)
datasets.structure: One record per subject per time-to-event parameter
datasets.description: Progression-free survival, overall survival and duration of response (responders only) with censoring reasons, stratification factors and subgroup covariates.

columns.name: STARTDT
columns.label: Time-to-Event Origin Date
columns.derivation: Randomization date for PFS and OS; date of the first documented response (the first CR/PR of the confirmed sequence) for DOR.

columns.name: ADT
columns.label: Analysis Date
columns.derivation: PFS: date of the first documented progression or death, or the censoring date given by CNSDTDSC (SAP rules, FDA oncology-endpoint guidance style - these are SAP rules, not regulations). OS: date of death or last known alive date. DOR: same event/censoring date as PFS, measured from the first confirmed response.

columns.name: AVAL
columns.label: Analysis Value
columns.derivation: ADT - STARTDT + 1 (days). Divide by 30.4375 for months.

columns.name: CNSR
columns.label: Censor
columns.derivation: PFS: 0 = event (documented progression or death), 1 = censored at the last adequate assessment, 2 = censored at randomization (no baseline or no adequate post-baseline assessment), 3 = censored at the last adequate assessment on or before new anticancer therapy, 4 = censored at the last adequate assessment before two or more consecutive missed assessments. OS: 0 = death, 1 = censored at the last known alive date.

columns.name: EVNTDESC
columns.label: Event or Censoring Description
columns.derivation: Event or censoring description (DISEASE PROGRESSION, DEATH, NEW ANTICANCER THERAPY BEFORE PD OR DEATH, PD OR DEATH AFTER >=2 MISSED ASSESSMENTS, NO BASELINE OR NO ADEQUATE POST-BASELINE ASSESSMENT, NO PD OR DEATH (ALIVE WITHOUT DOCUMENTED PROGRESSION), ALIVE AT LAST CONTACT).

columns.name: SRCSEQ
columns.label: Source Sequence Number
columns.derivation: --SEQ of the SDTM record that provided ADT (RS assessment, DS disposition record, or the record that provided the last known alive date).

datasets.name: data_issues
datasets.label: Answer key: injected data problems
datasets.structure: One record per issue (or per documented pattern)
datasets.description: Every problem injected into the raw layer, how it was resolved and the value SDTM uses. Includes true findings (dispensing errors, stratification errors, genuine extreme values) that must NOT be "cleaned".

columns.name: RESOLUTION
columns.label: How the issue was resolved (data-management note)

columns.name: CORRECTED_VALUE
columns.label: Value used in SDTM after resolution

columns.name: PROBLEM_NO
columns.label: Problem number in the study specification (section 3)

columns.name: N_RECORDS
columns.label: Number of raw records covered by this entry

datasets.name: sdtm_raw_map
datasets.label: Lineage: SDTM record to raw record map
datasets.structure: One record per SDTM record and contributing raw record
datasets.description: Traceability from every SDTM record back to the raw row(s) it came from, with notes on unit conversions, query corrections and derived records.

columns.name: SEQ
columns.label: Sequence number (--SEQ) of the SDTM record

columns.name: RAW_FILE
columns.label: Raw file the SDTM record came from
